page.overview:
Who is Ceran?

Ceran of the House of Raven was the son of King Correl of Cintra and Queen Eschiva of Sodden, and the brother of Cirra of Cintra and Coram I. He later became the king of Lyria.

Sometime before , Ceran and his older brother were hosted by King Egon of Lyria at his palace. During their stay, they met the king's twin daughters, Rigoberta and Impecca. While Coram married Rigoberta and returned to Cintra with her, Ceran married Impecca and remained in Lyria. After King Egon's death, Ceran ascended the Lyrian throne, adding the Cintran lions to the heraldry of Lyria and, in time, to that of Lyria and Rivia. The reign of Ceran and his wife was said to be long and just. His Lyrian line maintained strong ties with its Cintran counterparts, a connection that endured until the reigns of Queen Calanthe and Queen Meve.
